inv.desc_es:
Local comercial de obra nueva en Delicias, Zaragoza – Calle Graus 24

Local comercial situado en planta baja de Residencial Graus 24, promoción de obra nueva en Zaragoza junto a Paseo Calanda, en un entorno residencial consolidado, con comercio, servicios y transporte público en las proximidades.

Características:

• Aproximadamente 54 m² útiles
• Planta baja
• Local de obra nueva
• Entrega en bruto, para que el futuro propietario pueda plantear su distribución y acabados de acuerdo con las necesidades de su proyecto
• Integrado en un edificio residencial de 19 viviendas
• Entrega prevista en octubre de 2028, lo que permite distribuir los pagos hasta la entrega, una opción a valorar tanto para profesionales como para inversores

� Contacta para recibir plano, características técnicas, condiciones de venta y disponibilidad.

Gastos de compra en obra nueva en Aragón
Además del precio del inmueble, el comprador debe tener en cuenta los siguientes impuestos y gastos:

• IVA 21 %, aplicable con carácter general a locales comerciales.
• AJD: tipo general del 1,5 % en Aragón, sobre la base liquidable que corresponda.
• Notaría y Registro, según aranceles oficiales.
• En caso de financiación: tasación y aquellos gastos o costes que legal o contractualmente correspondan al comprador.

No se repercuten honorarios de intermediación inmobiliaria a la parte compradora.

El consumidor podrá solicitar información y documentación adicional relativa al inmueble, sus características, condiciones de la operación y del servicio de comercialización en la oficina o a través de.

Paravivir Inmobiliaria actúa exclusivamente como comercializadora en la compraventa, cuyas condiciones estarán sujetas a la aceptación expresa del promotor y a la posterior formalización del correspondiente contrato.

La información suministrada se corresponde con la disponible en la fecha de publicación y podrá variar como consecuencia de modificaciones o actualizaciones legales, fiscales, contractuales o del propio proyecto. Anuncio de carácter meramente informativo.

inv.desc_en:
New construction commercial space in Delicias, Zaragoza – 24 Graus Street

Commercial space located on the ground floor of Residencial Graus 24, a new construction development in Zaragoza next to Paseo Calanda, in a consolidated residential area with shops, services, and public transport nearby.

Features:

• Approximately 54 m² of usable space
• Ground floor
• New construction space
• Delivered in raw condition, allowing the future owner to plan the layout and finishes according to the needs of their project
• Integrated into a residential building of 19 homes
• Expected delivery in October 2028, which allows for payments to be spread out until delivery, an option to consider for both professionals and investors

Contact us to receive the floor plan, technical specifications, sales conditions, and availability.

Purchase costs for new construction in Aragon
In addition to the property price, the buyer must take into account the following taxes and expenses:

• 21% VAT, generally applicable to commercial premises.
• Stamp Duty (AJD): general rate of 1.5% in Aragon, on the corresponding taxable base.
• Notary and Registry fees, according to official tariffs.
• In case of financing: appraisal and those expenses or costs that legally or contractually correspond to the buyer.

No real estate brokerage fees are charged to the buyer.

The consumer may request additional information and documentation regarding the property, its characteristics, the conditions of the transaction, and the marketing service at the office or through.

Paravivir Inmobiliaria acts exclusively as a marketer in the sale, the conditions of which will be subject to the express acceptance of the developer and the subsequent formalization of the corresponding contract.

The information provided corresponds to that available on the date of publication and may vary as a result of legal, tax, contractual, or project-related modifications or updates. Advertisement for information purposes only.

More information at paravivir.es.

Purchase costs for new construction in Zaragoza
In addition to the price of the home, the buyer must take into account the following expenses:
• 10% VAT on the price of the home and linked annexes
• Stamp Duty (AJD): 1.5% in Aragon.
• Notary and Registry fees, according to official tariffs. Notary and registry fees regulated in Annex I of Royal Decree 1426/1989 and Annex I of Royal Decree 1427/1989, respectively.
• If a mortgage is required: Appraisal, conditions, and bank costs according to the entity chosen by the buyer; as well as administrative agency expenses and any others inherent to the sale.
No real estate brokerage fees are charged to the buyer.
The consumer, in accordance with current regulations, may request additional information and documentation regarding the property, its characteristics, the conditions of the transaction, and the marketing service at the office and/or through. The agency acts exclusively as a marketer in the sale, the conditions of which, in any case, will be subject to the express acceptance of the building developer and subsequent formalization of the contract. The information provided corresponds to that available at the date of publication, and may vary depending on circumstances or legal, contractual, and tax updates. Advertisement for information purposes only. More information at.
